title: elapsed

arguments.description: nonzero resets and arms the timer when creating the object

body: [elapsed] outputs the time elapsed since its timer was reset. By default, the first bang into the left input resets and arms the timer, and later bangs output the time since then without restarting it. If you give it a nonzero argument, the object is reset and armed at creation. The right inlet takes a bang that resets the timer. It is similar to Vanilla's [timer], but with a hot left inlet.
